definition:
Declination is the angular distance of the celestial equator on the celestial sphere. It is the celestial latitude.
[Range: -90° (south celestial pole); 0° at the celestial equator]
Abbreviation: dec; Symbol: δ

Description: A star is located at a declination of N° on the celestial sphere.

A star on the celestial sphere is specified by its declination and Right Ascension (RA).
